pages: Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, walks across the car park in a navy-blue duffle coat with wooden toggles, collar turned up. Middle distance: one parked estate car, one lamp post. Background: the low observatory block, one lit window, stars overhead. Clear cold November night, frost on the gravel.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, stands among close rows of thin steel dipoles pinned in the turf, one hand on a cable. Middle distance: a low wooden fence, a tractor. Background: black field, a dense band of stars and faint milky glow above the horizon.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, kneels at the pen unit and lifts one long wet roll of chart paper from the floor. Middle distance: two ink pens on their carriage, an ink can. Background: valve racks with red lamp light, a dark window.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, holds one sheet of wet chart paper up to the red lamp and lets it hang. Middle distance: the pen unit, a rack of valves. Background: the chart-room door, cold night beyond the glass. Red lamp light on his hands.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, draws one scalpel along a steel rule, cutting a strip of chart paper on the bench. Middle distance: cut strips squared in a heap, a tape dispenser. Background: red lamp light, valve rack shadow, the scalpel blade catching the light.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, stands over a hand's width of cut chart strips stacked on the bench, one hand flat on the top strip. Middle distance: a steel rule, a pair of dividers. Background: red lamp light, a dark window.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, holds one long strip of chart paper flat against the bench and sets his thumbnail on the printed scale along its edge. Middle distance: the stacked strips, a steel rule. Background: red lamp light, frost on the window.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, bends over one magnifying lens held close above the chart, one eye shut, his fingers steady on the rim. Middle distance: a steel rule, the printed scale along the paper edge. Background: red lamp light, the recorder's tall cabinets.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, stands under a round white-dial wall clock in the chart-room doorway and looks at it. Middle distance: a chair, one notebook on the bench. Background: the window's square of stars, small hours dark, his breath showing.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, lifts one grey stack of cut chart strips from the bench and tilts it toward the lamp. Middle distance: the scalpel, a heap of offcuts. Background: red lamp light, the dark window, no picket fence in it.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, turns one small tape reel on the deck and leans toward the loudspeaker in the corner. Middle distance: the replay head, a row of valve dials. Background: red lamp light, the window black with stars, and the reel turning slowly.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, lays one steel-cased wristwatch face up on the bench with his fingertip on the crown. Middle distance: the loudspeaker, the turning tape reel. Background: red lamp light on his hands and the dark room behind.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, writes on the back of his own left hand with one ballpoint pen, held upside down. Middle distance: the stacked chart strips, the wristwatch. Background: red lamp light, the window dark, the ink still wet on his skin.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, slides the top strip off one tall stack so a single column of small black marks stands up like comb teeth. Middle distance: the scalpel, a steel rule. Background: red lamp light, the recorder cabinets.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, holds one cut strip up to the red lamp and squints at the lean of a single black mark on it. Middle distance: the stack of strips, the lens. Background: valve racks, dark window, his face close to the paper.

Miss Bell, a young woman of twenty-four with dark hair pinned up, wears a grey cardigan over a white shirt and lays one long chart roll flat on the canteen table under a white plate. Middle distance: a thermos, a heap of cut strips. Background: high canteen windows, dawn grey.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, sits holding one scalpel upright in his fist beside the cut strips. Middle distance: the stacked strips, a sheet of paper. Background: red lamp light, the window and its stars, his head tilted to listen.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, writes on one sheet of paper with a ballpoint pen and stops to sign his own name beneath the figure. Middle distance: the notebook, the stack of strips. Background: red lamp light, valve racks, the ink shining.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat, writes a second figure in one open notebook with a ballpoint pen, beneath the first. Middle distance: the pen unit, a log book. Background: red lamp light, the window black, one hand flat on the open spread.

Ben Whitlock, a boy of sixteen with short dark hair, in a navy-blue duffle coat with the toggles fastened, walks down Ryle Road, one small notebook in his pocket, frost underfoot. Middle distance: a bare hedge, fence posts, one lit gate lamp behind. Background: open fields, first grey of dawn.

Miss Bell, a young woman of twenty-four with dark hair pinned up, in a grey cardigan over a white shirt, bends close over one brass clock on a workbench, one finger on its rim. Middle distance: a stack of machine charts, a notebook. Background: an open window, night sky, her hair coming loose.
